title.zh: 合作社（第 97 条下的豁免）（第 4 号）命令 2013
title.vi: Lệnh Hợp tác xã (Miễn trừ theo Điều 97) (Số 4) 2013
title.th: คำสั่งสหกรณ์ (การยกเว้นตามมาตรา 97) (ฉบับที่ 4) 2013

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Co-operative Societies (Exemption under Section 97) (No. 4) Order 2013 and shall come into operation on 27th December 2013.

2. ITE Co-operative Society Ltd shall be exempt from section 89(3) of the Act, in so far as —
(a)any moneys remaining after the application of its funds to the purposes specified in section 88 of the Act; and
(b)any sums unclaimed after 2 years from the date of cancellation of its registration,
shall be donated to the ITE Endowment Fund, instead of being transferred to the Co-operative Societies Liquidation Account.
